trend_pullback.rationale: Test resumption after a pullback inside an established rising trend, rather than repeated direction-only momentum.
trend_pullback.rules: SMA20>SMA100, SMA100 now>SMA100 five bars earlier; previous close<=previous SMA20; current close>current SMA20 AND current open. Stop=min(last3lows)-0.25*ATR14; target=close+2R; maxhold48h.

breakout_retest.rationale: Test a pullback to a frozen broken range high; do not buy every new channel high.
breakout_retest.rules: Most recent breakout among previous6bars: breakout close>max20 preceding highs AND preceding close<=that fixed level. All subsequent lows (including current) >=level-0.5*ATR14current. Current low<=level+0.25*ATR AND current close>level AND open. Stop=min(lows from first bar after breakout through current)-0.25ATR; target=close+2R; maxhold48h; source identity fixed breakout timestamp+level, used once per wallet.

compression_expansion.rationale: Test a range breakout only after unusually compressed realised close dispersion.
compression_expansion.rules: Previous20close populationSD <0.75*mean(previous100 rolling20 populationSDs). Currentclose>max(previous20highs) AND currenthigh-low>1.5*ATR14current. Stop=close-2ATR; target=close+3R; maxhold48h.

range_sweep_reclaim.rationale: Test observable failed range-low excursion and recovery to the mean in a mechanically flat context; not evidence of actual order-book liquidity.
range_sweep_reclaim.rules: Absolute currentSMA100 minus SMA100 five bars earlier <0.5ATR14current. Currentlow<min(previous20lows), currentclose>that fixed low AND currentopen, currentclose<currentSMA20. Stop=currentlow-0.25ATR; target=currentSMA20; require reward/risk>=1.5; maxhold24h.
